description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 23.08.2021 to 29.08.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This falls under the category of regulatory matters and statutory instruments, specifically concerning the legal framework for customs and trade regulations.
